hypothesis: A fresh StarWAM full30 action expert on the common v7 valid-window split will retain the strong visual and language dependence seen at the historical s100 checkpoint while providing a directly comparable s100 anchor for the dense H3 carrier tournament; failure to retain either condition signal retires this branch.
single_variable: Replace the historical v8 frame-indexed source/split and cache identity with the common v7 valid-window source/split and bit-parity dual-output cache; the frozen INT8-H3 feature adapter, RMS scale, full30 ActionDiT, objective, optimizer, schedule, seed and 800-sample budget stay fixed.
parent_baseline: Historical H3-StarWAM v8 full30 chain: s100 retained visual/language response, but s850/s913 collapsed to near-zero visual response and more than 90% lower language response; it is a bounded parent, not a successful closed-loop policy.

architecture.paper: A video-DiT observation representation conditions an independent action transformer.
architecture.upstream_code: Trainable Wan2.2-TI2V-5B final-layer features are pooled to 32 tokens; ActionDiT is 30 layers, hidden1024, FFN4096 and 40x128 attention; feature timestep token is disabled.
architecture.local: Frozen INT8 MiniMax-H3 layer49 condition tokens are pooled to 32, projected 5376 to 5120 and consumed by the byte-pinned full30 ActionDiT with no feature timestep token.
architecture.rationale: H3 replaces Wan2.2 by project design, and the backbone remains frozen because full-H3 action tuning has already regressed world-model capability; this is a backbone port, not an official reproduction.

architecture.paper: The original Wan feature width and scale enter the action context directly.
architecture.upstream_code: No scalar feature rescaling is used because the Wan backbone and action context share the released representation scale.
architecture.local: A fixed 0.009606920816877307 scalar matches audited H3 feature RMS 7322.443 to text-context RMS 70.346 before the learned projector.
architecture.rationale: Raw H3 scale caused thousand-fold larger losses and unstable gradients; the paired scale gate established this as a necessary H3 docking adapter rather than a claimed StarWAM mechanism.

data.field: dual-camera current observation and dense action-window starts
data.paper: LIBERO demonstrations with current observation conditioning.
data.upstream_code: Primary and wrist cameras are horizontally concatenated; the action chunk is 32 raw control steps and feature_condition_input=observation uses only the current frame.
data.local: The v7 cache encodes the same two horizontally concatenated cameras into first_frame_latents [1,24,1,14,28], pairs 32 raw 20Hz actions, and contains 200779 train windows from 1542 episodes with 22150 validation windows from 170 disjoint episodes.
data.rationale: Image pixels, current-observation semantics and action rate align; H3-specific latent encoding is accounted for under the architecture port.

data.local: 180843 of 200779 v7 train IDs also occur in the v8 train split (90.0707%); 5579 of each run's first 7704 IDs overlap (Jaccard 0.567606).
data.rationale: The high overlap blocks another 963-step replay; only the 800-sample common-protocol anchor has enough incremental value to run.

action.upstream_code: 7D horizon32 action, 8D proprio, train statistics min/max normalization clipped to [-5,5], with padded action masking.
action.local: Exact 7D horizon32 and 8D proprio contract with v7 train-only min/max statistics, clip5 and the same pad mask behavior.
action.rationale: The backbone port does not change action semantics.

objective.paper: Flow matching predicts continuous action chunks.
objective.upstream_code: Shift-5 scheduler and timestep-weighted masked velocity MSE from StarWAM modules.
objective.local: The trainer imports the scheduler and loss directly from the pinned StarWAM source and keeps continuous FP32 timesteps; auxiliary regression and paired-margin weights remain zero.
objective.rationale: No local auxiliary objective is enabled in C03.

optimization.paper: The released StarWAM policy is trained for roughly 106850 optimizer steps and evaluated near step100000.
optimization.upstream_code: AdamW LR1e-4, weight decay0.01, betas(0.9,0.95), clip1, BF16, warmup1000 and cosine decay; released global batch128.
optimization.local: Eight A800 ranks, global batch8, seed42, warmup1000, cosine horizon21700 and exactly 100 optimizer steps over 800 unique v7 rows, with checkpoints s1/s50/s100.
optimization.rationale: This is only a tournament anchor. Historical late conditioning collapse forbids automatic scale-up even though the official recipe is much longer.

evaluation.field: condition-aware offline gate followed by fixed closed-loop canary
evaluation.paper: LIBERO task success is the endpoint.
evaluation.upstream_code: 50 trials per task, 10 tasks per suite, 10 action denoising steps and replan_steps10.
evaluation.local: At s1/s50/s100 use the fixed v7 balanced-80 same-noise evaluator with language replacement and no-self-map visual shuffle; only s100 may run the fixed goal0/spatial0 trial0 rollout if it retains condition dependence and action/gripper quality.
evaluation.rationale: The bounded canary can reject the branch but cannot reproduce the paper's 2000-trial claim.

repeat_audit.decision_effect: Cap C03 at s100; do not repeat s963 without a new condition-preserving mechanism.

decision.rationale: A short common-v7 anchor is justified for cross-family comparison, but the 90.07% dataset overlap and replicated late conditioning collapse make another 963-step baseline replay wasteful. Launch only after the StarWAM cache has a complete ID/schema audit; stop at s100 regardless of ordinary regression improvement.
decision.launch_command: On one 8xA800 node, run three strict stages with /mnt/h3-wam/runtime/h3-int8-native/bin/python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=8 scripts/h3wam/train_h3_int8_starwam_action.py /mnt/h3-wam/data/v7_multisuite_dense_candidate/manifest_train_uniform.jsonl --source-manifest /mnt/h3-wam/data/v7_multisuite_dense_candidate/manifest_all.jsonl --cache-root /mnt/h3-wam/data/v7_dense_h3_cache --feature-subdir h3_int8_starwam_last32_dense_v1 --feature-input-scale 0.009606920816877307 --action-layers 30 --learning-rate 1e-4 --weight-decay 0.01 --warmup-steps 1000 --scheduler-horizon 21700 --action-shift 5 --verify-h3-checkpoint-sha256 --per-device-batch-size 1 --gradient-accumulation-steps 1 --num-workers 0. Stages: s1=(--steps 1 --sample-offset 0 --limit 8), s50=(--steps 49 --sample-offset 8 --limit 392 --load-checkpoint s1), s100=(--steps 50 --sample-offset 400 --limit 400 --load-checkpoint s50); save and fresh-restore each checkpoint, then evaluate s1/s50/s100 on the fixed v7 balanced-80 protocol.

promotion_gate.promote_to_rollout: s100 must keep non-collapsed visual-shuffle and language-replacement action deltas, improve at least one physical or gripper metric over s1 without material regression in the other, keep every required gradient finite/non-zero and restore max_abs0.
stop: feature-projector gradient is zero or non-finite
visual-shuffle response collapses to numerical noise
language response falls by more than 80% from s1 without a closed-loop gain
any cache, sample-identity or restore contract fails
promotion_gate.long_training: NO_GO irrespective of s100 ordinary action MSE; any extension requires a separately audited condition-preserving mechanism and a new dossier.
